name: Theodoor van Thulden

summary.text: Theodoor van Thulden was a Flemish painter, draughtsman and engraver born in 's-Hertogenbosch in the duchy of Brabant. He is mainly known for his altarpieces, mythological subjects, allegorical works and portraits.
